description: Monthly import unit values for support and precursor materials on the academic (reference) price basis. Each series is one HS 6-digit code reported by the United States (reporter 842) for imports from the world (partner 0), customs value divided by net weight. All grades and partners are combined, so a series is a bulk market level, not a catalyst-grade quote.
source: UN Comtrade Plus, https://comtradeplus.un.org (free keyless preview snapshot; optional key for scheduled collection)

series.name: Calcined alumina (non-corundum), U.S. import unit value
series.note: Dominated by smelter-grade flows; catalyst-carrier gamma alumina trades above this level.

series.name: Artificial corundum (alpha-alumina), U.S. import unit value
series.note: Abrasive and refractory grades dominate the volume.

series.name: Titanium oxides, U.S. import unit value
series.note: Pigment grade dominates; anatase catalyst grades trade above this level.

series.name: Silicon dioxide, U.S. import unit value
series.note: Precipitated, fumed and gel silicas combined.

series.name: Activated carbon, U.S. import unit value
series.note: All grades combined; catalyst-support grades trade above this level.

series.name: Carbon black, U.S. import unit value
series.note: Rubber grades dominate; conductive grades trade above this level.

series.name: Synthetic zeolites and aluminosilicates, U.S. import unit value
series.note: HS 2842.10 is broader than zeolites (detergent builders, molecular sieves).

series.name: Magnesia (fused or dead-burned), U.S. import unit value
Cerium compounds, U.S. import unit value
series.note: Oxide, carbonate and chloride combined; kept beside the USGS cerium-oxide anchor rather than replacing it.
